title: Led Zeppelin IV
headline: A press agent called Zeppelin's album cover a career-ender.
caption:
Putting out your fourth album with no name on it is the most confident move in rock.

A press agent warned Jimmy Page that, after a year's absence, a sleeve with no words on it could sink them. Atlantic insisted on a title too. Page held firm: "We just happened to have a lot of faith in what we were doing." It went on to sell over 37 million copies. That nameless sleeve held 'Stairway to Heaven'.

Confidence or pure luck? Tell me I'm wrong.

🎧 Key track: "Stairway to Heaven" by Led Zeppelin (@ledzeppelin)
